purpose: The closing offer of a documentation page, parked at the foot of the "On this page" rail after the outline. It is a docs card built like every other card on the page: a `FrameBox` with corner marks, a flat `--bg-surface` face, the wordmark at the headline size, a headline, a subtitle and full-width stacked actions. Set on the rail scale (14 px headline, 12 px copy) so it never out-shouts the page outline. Every string is content passed by the page.
useWhen: Once per documentation page, last in the right rail.
avoidWhen: In the prose column — use `CallToAction` on marketing pages or a `DocCard` link in docs.
bestPractices: One primary action; a secondary only when it is a real alternative (talk to sales).
A one-line headline and a one-line subtitle.
